title: Source: Google asked Google Play app devs to join a "confidential content offer pilot", offering to pay for access to codebases to use them to train AI tools (Jason Koebler/404 Media)
summary: Jason Koebler / 404 Media: Source: Google asked Google Play app devs to join a “confidential content offer pilot”, offering to pay for access to codebases to use them to train AI tools — Google is trying to buy code from some Android developers as part of a “confidential” program.
contentText:
Jason Koebler / 404 Media :

Source: Google asked Google Play app devs to join a “confidential content offer pilot”, offering to pay for access to codebases to use them to train AI tools   —  Google is trying to buy code from some Android developers as part of a “confidential” program.
